teaching_promise: The viewer can trace one protected inference from an explicit adversary and leakage model through a guarantee vector, compositional primitive choice, measured artifact, independent verification, stale-attestation failure, and a bounded handoff without mistaking an attestation or secure-compute label for semantic correctness or end-to-end privacy.

story.concrete_case: A protected inference operation binds input, model, intermediate state, output, attestation, leakage, policy, freshness, cost, and recovery; a verifier checks a committed artifact while replay and wrong-model failures remain visible.
story.opening_question: What exactly does a protected-compute claim guarantee when users, providers, auditors, artifacts, and trust anchors do not share custody?
story.payoff: A compositional execution contract separates guarantee classes, names leakage and adversary scope, and admits only a bounded verified receipt.
story.transfer: Carry the protected-execution record into Model-Weight Custody and Hardware Roots of Trust, where weights, optimizer state, adapters, caches, and derivatives can be copied or reconstructed.

art_direction.visual_thesis: Confidential and verifiable AI is a compositional execution contract with explicit leakage, freshness, and verifier policy, not a single secure-compute badge.
art_direction.signature_image: A dark protected-computation lab routes an input capsule and model vault through a guarantee matrix, compositional primitive rack, measured enclave, verifier, and fallback airlock.
art_direction.visual_world: A trust-boundary control room with an execution contract, input capsule, model vault, guarantee matrix, primitive rack, attestation receipt, independent verifier, and fallback airlock.
art_direction.composition_rule: Keep user input left, model/provider custody right, execution contract above, guarantee matrix central, verifier and unsupported properties below, and the fallback airlock at the far edge.
art_direction.palette_rule: Blue marks inputs and measured identity, amber marks contract and policy, violet marks cryptographic/computational protection, green marks an admitted guarantee, red marks leakage/failure, and gray marks unsupported scope; every color is labeled.
art_direction.typography_rule: Use compact uppercase labels for adversary, asset, leakage, primitive, artifact, freshness, verifier, fallback, and semantic boundary; narration supplies the technical meaning.
art_direction.motion_character: Assets register, guarantee rows separate, primitive paths compose, commitments bind, a verifier appraises a receipt, replay and wrong-model failures branch to quarantine, and a bounded handoff closes.
art_direction.camera_rule: Open across distrust boundaries, tighten on guarantee separation and primitive composition, widen to artifact verification and failures, then return to the evidence ceiling and successor custody.
art_direction.surface_rule: Every panel names an asset, adversary, leakage route, guarantee, primitive, artifact, policy, freshness, verifier, cost, fallback, or evidence boundary; semantic validity remains separate.
art_direction.ending_image: A finite protected-execution receipt seals while a model-weight custody vault opens beyond the airlock.

audio_direction.narration_style: Concrete, calm, and guarantee-specific; the execution contract carries the causal arc.
audio_direction.pacing_arc: Open on distrust boundaries, separate guarantee classes, compose primitives, trace one measured operation and verifier, route stale/wrong-model failures, then narrow the evidence and hand off.
audio_direction.duration_rationale: The 05:13.180 runtime stays below the six-minute soft target while preserving guarantee, leakage, freshness, verifier, cost, and semantic-boundary distinctions; six minutes is a soft target, not a hard constraint.
audio_direction.music_policy: No music; capsule movement, matrix updates, and verifier/airlock changes carry the rhythm.
audio_direction.sound_effect_policy: No sound effects; labels, arrows, boundaries, crosses, and receipt stamps encode meaning.

accessibility.color_redundancy: Every guarantee and outcome uses labels, enclosure, position, arrow direction, line style, or crosses in addition to color.
accessibility.motion_redundancy: Every primitive and failure settles into a named state; the guarantee matrix, verifier, and evidence boundary remain legible when motion is reduced.
accessibility.integrated_description: The adjacent transcript names distrust roles, assets, guarantee vector, leakage, primitive composition, artifact commitments, freshness, verifier policy, failures, and evidence ceiling.
accessibility.caption_plan: Use exact receipt-derived cues from the pinned 22-segment narration; the adjacent transcript describes each material state change.
accessibility.reduced_motion_assessment: No flash, spin, shake, or continuous camera drift; guarantee and trust relations survive pause and reduced motion.

beats.narration: AI inference crosses distrust boundaries: users may hide inputs, providers may protect weights, and auditors may need to verify an executed artifact.
beats.visual_purpose: Open with the custody split among user, provider, and auditor.
beats.visual_action: Place an input capsule at the user edge, a model vault at the provider edge, and an auditor outside a dashed trust boundary around an execution core.
beats.attention_target: The three parties and the boundary between them.
beats.composition: User left, provider right, auditor below, execution core center.
beats.motion_curve: Progressive role reveal with settled boundary.
beats.camera_action: Widen from execution core to all distrust roles.
beats.hold_purpose: Make custody separation the opening problem.
beats.evidence_boundary: Role diagram; no confidentiality result.

beats.narration: Output integrity may be required without giving another party unrestricted custody. Transport encryption stops before computation begins, and ordinary privacy policy does not govern stored model artifacts.
beats.sync_anchor: Transport encryption stops before computation begins
beats.visual_purpose: Show where familiar protections stop.
beats.visual_action: Move an encrypted packet through a transport tunnel that ends before the execution core; show a privacy-policy card and model vault on opposite sides of an uncovered computation boundary.
beats.attention_target: The gap between encrypted transport and protected execution.
beats.composition: Transport tunnel left; computation boundary center; stored artifact right.
beats.motion_curve: Tunnel opens, then a hard stop.
beats.camera_action: Tighten on the uncovered compute interval.
beats.hold_purpose: Separate transport confidentiality from execution guarantees.
beats.evidence_boundary: Boundary critique; no attack or privacy estimate.

beats.narration: Neither policy nor hardware custody supplies a guarantee-by-guarantee contract for input confidentiality, model confidentiality, computation integrity, output authenticity, attestation freshness, leakage, verifier policy, cost, and recovery.
beats.visual_purpose: Reject the single-label view of protected computation.
beats.visual_action: Place policy and hardware-custody badges beside a red empty guarantee matrix; show the required guarantee rows waiting to be specified.
beats.attention_target: The empty rows between policy and hardware badges.
beats.composition: Policy left, hardware right, empty matrix center.
beats.motion_curve: Badges appear, then matrix remains unfilled.
beats.camera_action: Tighten on missing rows.
beats.hold_purpose: Make guarantee classes non-interchangeable.
beats.evidence_boundary: Matrix requirement; no primitive result.

beats.narration: A compositional execution contract names the adversary, protected assets, permitted leakage, trust anchors, proof or attestation statement, verifier policy, freshness, revocation, performance budget, and authorization boundary.
beats.visual_purpose: Construct the contract before selecting a primitive.
beats.visual_action: Populate an amber contract header with adversary, assets, leakage, trust anchors, statement, verifier policy, freshness, revocation, performance, and authorization fields.
beats.attention_target: Adversary and permitted leakage binding before execution.
beats.composition: Contract above matrix; primitive rack remains unopened.
beats.camera_action: Track contract fields across the header.
beats.hold_purpose: Make scope prospective and compositional.
beats.evidence_boundary: Contract schema does not prove semantic correctness.

beats.narration: No primitive or attestation may be treated as proof of semantic correctness, legitimate purpose, or end-to-end privacy.
beats.visual_purpose: Set the semantic and purpose boundary before implementation.
beats.visual_action: Place a primitive badge and attestation receipt inside the contract, then cross semantic correctness, legitimate purpose, and end-to-end privacy exits.
beats.attention_target: The crossed properties outside the measured statement.
beats.composition: Primitive/receipt center; unsupported properties outside dashed boundary.
beats.camera_action: Tighten on semantic boundary.
beats.hold_purpose: Prevent semantic laundering.
beats.evidence_boundary: No semantic or purpose result.

beats.narration: Express the requested guarantee vector separately for input privacy, model privacy, intermediate-state privacy, computation integrity, output authenticity, availability, and auditability.
beats.visual_purpose: Build the guarantee matrix as separate rows.
beats.visual_action: Populate seven labeled rows with distinct sockets for input, model, intermediate state, integrity, authenticity, availability, and auditability.
beats.attention_target: Separate row identities rather than one secure badge.
beats.composition: Matrix fills center; input and model assets remain at edges.
beats.camera_action: Widen across all guarantee rows.
beats.hold_purpose: Make guarantee dimensions claim-bearing.
beats.evidence_boundary: Rows specify scope; no guarantee is established.

beats.narration: Choose among FHE, MPC, zero-knowledge proofs, confidential execution, private retrieval, differential privacy, or a hybrid composition against an explicit adversary and leakage model.
beats.visual_purpose: Compare primitives against the declared threat rather than by reputation.
beats.visual_action: Open a primitive rack with FHE, MPC, ZK, confidential execution, private retrieval, DP, and hybrid tiles; route only threat-model-compatible tiles toward the matrix.
beats.attention_target: The adversary/leakage filter before primitive admission.
beats.composition: Primitive rack left; adversary/leakage filter center; matrix right.
beats.camera_action: Pan across primitive choices and filter.
beats.hold_purpose: Make primitive choice conditional on threat scope.
beats.evidence_boundary: Menu comparison; no performance claim.

beats.narration: A concrete implementation trace makes the proposal testable.
beats.visual_purpose: Move one bounded inference into the protected lab.
beats.visual_action: Open a single inference lane from the contract into a contained protected-execution cell with a verifier outside the cell.
beats.attention_target: The bounded cell and independent verifier.
beats.composition: Protected cell center; verifier outside; broad release gate closed.
beats.camera_action: Tighten on the protected cell.
beats.hold_purpose: Show a test surface without claiming deployment.
beats.evidence_boundary: Trace is local and bounded.

beats.narration: Build a guarantee matrix and local demonstration for one bounded inference operation with explicit adversary and leakage models, artifact and configuration commitments, freshness, independent verification, native-versus-protected latency and cost accounting,
beats.visual_purpose: Bind the operation, artifacts, verifier, and cost measurements.
beats.visual_action: Commit code, model, configuration, data, platform, nonce, and policy tiles into the protected cell; add freshness, independent verification, and native/protected cost lanes.
beats.attention_target: Artifact commitments and independent verification beside cost.
beats.composition: Commitments above cell; cost lanes below; verifier outside.
beats.camera_action: Pan from commitments to cost rows.
beats.hold_purpose: Make the measured artifact reproducible and comparable.
beats.evidence_boundary: Local accounting; no production cost claim.

beats.narration: negative tests for replay and mismatched artifacts, and a no-authorization non-claim. Choose among FHE, MPC, zero-knowledge proofs, confidential execution, private retrieval, differential privacy, or hybrid composition against an explicit adversary and leakage model.
beats.visual_purpose: Exercise replay and mismatch failures before accepting a receipt.
beats.visual_action: Send a stale nonce and mismatched model/configuration into red negative-test lanes; retain the threat-matched primitive composition in the protected cell.
beats.attention_target: The replay and mismatch lanes being rejected.
beats.composition: Negative tests left; valid composition center; fallback below.
beats.motion_curve: Failures branch, valid path remains bounded.
beats.camera_action: Tighten on stale and mismatch tokens.
beats.hold_purpose: Make negative controls part of the contract.
beats.evidence_boundary: Negative tests do not prove complete security.

beats.narration: Bind code, model, configuration, data commitments, platform state, nonce or epoch, and policy identity into evidence that a distinct verifier appraises.
beats.visual_purpose: Move appraisal outside the proposer and execution cell.
beats.visual_action: Seal code/model/config/data/platform/nonce/policy commitments into an attestation receipt and route it to an independent verifier panel.
beats.attention_target: Verifier separation from the protected cell.
beats.composition: Cell left; receipt center; verifier right outside trust boundary.
beats.camera_action: Widen from receipt to verifier.
beats.hold_purpose: Make appraisal custody explicit.
beats.evidence_boundary: Appraisal proves only its statement scope.

beats.narration: Keep cryptographic correctness, attested identity, model quality, semantic validity, user authorization, and lawful purpose as separate claim classes.
beats.visual_purpose: Prevent guarantee laundering across cryptography, semantics, and authority.
beats.visual_action: Lay six separate claim lanes beneath the receipt; draw no shortcut arrow between cryptographic correctness and semantic validity or authorization.
beats.attention_target: The missing shortcut arrows between claim classes.
beats.composition: Six claim lanes span the frame; receipt above.
beats.motion_curve: Parallel lane assembly with crossed shortcuts.
beats.camera_action: Widen across claim classes.
beats.hold_purpose: Keep what was proved separate from what was not.
beats.evidence_boundary: Separation is discipline, not a result.

beats.narration: The design can still fail. Guarantee laundering collapses confidentiality, integrity, privacy, authorization, and correctness into one secure-compute label. Stale or replayed attestation is accepted after artifact, platform, policy, or revocation state changed.
beats.visual_purpose: Show collapsed guarantees and stale attestation as explicit failures.
beats.visual_action: Compress separate rows into a misleading secure-compute badge, then reveal stale artifact/platform/policy/revocation tokens crossing a freshness gate.
beats.attention_target: The stale receipt crossing the freshness gate.
beats.composition: Collapsed badge left; freshness gate center; stale tokens right.
beats.camera_action: Tighten on stale receipt and revocation state.
beats.hold_purpose: Make freshness and claim separation operational.
beats.evidence_boundary: Failure route; no incidence claim.

beats.narration: Side channels, outputs, access patterns, logs, caches, or failure timing leak protected information. The proved computation faithfully executes the wrong model, wrong preprocessing, wrong policy, or semantically invalid relation.
beats.visual_purpose: Show leakage routes and the wrong-artifact problem.
beats.visual_action: Fan side-channel, output, access-pattern, log, cache, and timing lanes around the protected cell; route wrong model/preprocessing/policy/relation tokens to a semantic-failure terminal.
beats.attention_target: Leaks outside the cell and wrong model inside the cell.
beats.composition: Protected cell center; leakage lanes around; wrong-artifact terminal right.
beats.motion_curve: Leak fan followed by semantic branch.
beats.camera_action: Widen around side channels then tighten on wrong model.
beats.hold_purpose: Keep confidentiality and semantic validity separate.
beats.evidence_boundary: Leakage taxonomy; no measured leakage result.

beats.narration: The correct response is to stop, narrow, quarantine, compensate, or retain an owned residual rather than narrate uncertainty away.
beats.visual_purpose: Route failures to typed, owned dispositions.
beats.visual_action: Send leakage and semantic-invalidity tokens into stop, narrow, quarantine, compensate, and owned-residual terminals with a receipt and owner.
beats.attention_target: Owned residual and fallback receipt.
beats.composition: Failures left; disposition fan right; owner/receipt below.
beats.camera_action: Widen across all dispositions.
beats.hold_purpose: Make uncertainty operationally accountable.
beats.evidence_boundary: Disposition design; no recovery result.

beats.narration: This chapter remains Design rationale at argument support. Its contracts, examples, tests, or local artifacts establish only their encoded scope. The chapter names proof targets rather than pretending they are already closed.
beats.visual_purpose: Place the protected-computation proposal at its support ceiling.
beats.visual_action: Stamp DESIGN RATIONALE / ARGUMENT SUPPORT over the local cell and verifier while proof targets remain open beyond a double boundary.
beats.attention_target: The support stamp and open targets.
beats.object_after: Narrow support state with open proof targets
beats.composition: Local artifacts left; proof targets outside right.
beats.camera_action: Tighten on support state.
beats.hold_purpose: Prevent the visual from promoting a security claim.
beats.evidence_boundary: No chapter-core promotion occurs.

beats.narration: A finite protected-execution record may hand off only when guarantees, adversary, leakage, artifact, freshness, verifier policy, fallback, and unsupported properties are explicit; no theorem proves semantic correctness, authorization, or end-to-end privacy.
beats.visual_purpose: Show handoff preconditions without granting unsupported semantics.
beats.visual_action: Populate a fallback airlock checklist with guarantees, adversary, leakage, artifact, freshness, verifier, fallback, and unsupported properties; cross semantic correctness, authorization, and end-to-end privacy exits.
beats.attention_target: Unsupported properties as required handoff rows.
beats.composition: Checklist center; unsupported properties right beyond red boundary.
beats.camera_action: Tighten on freshness/verifier rows then widen.
beats.hold_purpose: Make handoff custody and nonclaims explicit.
beats.evidence_boundary: Record does not prove semantics or authorization.

beats.narration: An attestation proves only the appraised statement about a measured environment; it does not prove trustworthy intent, correct policy, or correct output meaning.
beats.sync_anchor: appraised statement about a measured environment
beats.visual_purpose: Limit attestation to its measured statement.
beats.visual_action: Place an attestation receipt over a measured environment panel; route intent, policy, and output meaning to separate crossed nonclaim lanes.
beats.attention_target: The narrow measured statement inside the receipt.
beats.composition: Measured environment left; receipt center; unsupported semantics right.
beats.camera_action: Tighten on the statement scope.
beats.hold_purpose: Keep attested identity separate from intent and meaning.
beats.evidence_boundary: Attestation does not prove semantic correctness.

beats.narration: No chapter claim or evidence state is promoted by this visual. A named mechanism is not proof of correct implementation or useful deployment. A local check or formal model does not establish real-world enforcement. No safety, transfer, state-of-the-art, AGI, or ASI conclusion follows.

beats.visual_action: Keep the local protected receipt inside a media boundary; cross implementation, deployment, enforcement, safety, transfer, frontier, AGI, and ASI exits outside.

beats.camera_action: Widen to all blocked claims.

beats.visual_purpose: Align live source and derivative at one support ceiling.
beats.visual_action: Connect the live chapter card and protected receipt with a shared evidence-ceiling line below all broad claim badges.
beats.attention_target: The shared support-state line.

beats.narration: At most, this visual explains the chapter's design rationale at argument support; it adds no empirical, deployment, safety, transfer, state-of-the-art, AGI, or ASI result. The next chapter is Model-Weight Custody and Hardware Roots of Trust.
